events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Memories
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles walked that iconic zebra crossing! 'Abbey Road' dropped today in '69. What's your go-to track from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! From 'Brass in Pocket' to 'Don't Get Me Wrong', what's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Our Kid is 54! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem he sang?

events.title: iPod's 25th Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple first announced the iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Can you believe it's 25 years since the iPod changed how we listened to music? Remember scrolling through your 1,000 songs in your pocket? What was the first album you put on yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the UK release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your ultimate 007 moment or song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. Which of his songs means the most to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Celebrated comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the comedy legend, John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite moment of his genius?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, we remember the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who left us on this day in '91. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Reflection
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that saw them evolve their sound. What's your top pick from the record?
